description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of test cases for Git operations including repository setup, cloning, backfilling objects, sparse checkout, and partial clones. It orchestrates multiple Git commands to validate behaviors such as object backfilling, sparse checkout handling, and cloning over HTTP.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing failure cases.

methods.name: test_trace2_data
methods.description: Analyzes trace files to check for specific events or counts during Git operations.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the line count of output files to verify the number of items.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or gets Git configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server to facilitate testing of HTTP-related Git operations.
